description: The work board: tasks by status, by who has them or the kind of work (`assignee`), or by goal; `q` searches titles; `mine: true` only what you asked for (your requests). Each row says its kind of work (`run_type`, `run_type_name`: Engineering, Testing…) when the server knows it.

assignee.description: an agent's id, role key or name (list_agents), or a kind of work by its key (engineer, creative, qa…; list_kinds_of_work): in a one-assistant workspace the assistant has every task, so the key finds that kind

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

name: list_tasks
title: List tasks
